Adjusting for one-time items, American posted earnings of 15 cents a share.

 American cut its 2026 adjusted forecast, expecting a range between a loss of as much as 65 cents per share to earnings of as much as 65 cents per share.
 Volatile fuel prices have hit airline results, though carriers have increased airfare.
 CEO Robert Isom told CNBC last month that the carrier is trying to catch up to Delta and United, though its profit gap has widened.
